name: xcodebuildmcp-cli
title: XcodeBuildMCP CLI
description: Run deterministic Apple-platform discovery, build, test, simulator, debug, log, screenshot, and UI inspection workflows through the official XcodeBuildMCP executable.
notes:
## What it does

This is the verification and tool-execution capability for Apple-platform work. It uses help-first discovery, checks session defaults, keeps workflows minimal, and reports real build/test/run/UI results.

## Boundary

It does not own product decisions, visual design, SwiftUI architecture, API parity, or authorization. It never silently installs tools or falls back to raw xcodebuild, xcrun, or simctl.
